spans_domain_and_ui.description: True only when work spans both UI and non-UI domain categories.

layer.description: ui is Svelte interface work; domain is every non-UI change to the product, including backend and database work; workflow is a change to the driver itself under workflow/ and the docs that describe it.

ui_called_exports.description: Exported names this slice changes that files under src/routes/, src/lib/components/ or src/lib/ui/ call. Only a domain slice ever lists any; every other slice sends an empty array.
